PM Modi inaugurates India-backed restoration of Prambanan Temple in Indonesia

Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited Indonesia's 10th-century Prambanan temple complex, a UNESCO-listed site dedicated to Lord Shiva. During the visit, he jointly inaugurated a restoration project for the temple with Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto. The initiative highlights India's role in preserving shared cultural heritage and strengthening civilizational ties with Southeast Asian nations.
